0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, on a five-game winning streak) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, coming off a loss) in the Spurs' eighth game of the season. San Antonio sits 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the West, while Dallas is 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, and 9th in the West. The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on 2026-10-24, and they won the 2025-26 series 4-0. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Max Christie day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision.
